name: Knowledge Vault
summary: Shared source of truth for Buddy systems.

links.reason: Buddy Agent consumes compiled memory and graph context.
Buddy Brain consumes durable project memory and council context.
The knowledge graph is the machine-readable substrate inside KnowledgeVault.

name: Buddy Agent
summary: Primary Buddy runtime and execution agent repository.

links.reason: Buddy Agent should load compiled graph context before acting.
Codex-style task execution should use graph context for repo and project state.

name: Buddy Brain
summary: Governance, council, operator policy, and continuity layer for Buddy systems.

links.reason: Buddy Brain uses KnowledgeVault as durable public-safe memory.
Buddy Brain defines and coordinates council-style review roles.

name: Omni Buddy
summary: Local multimodal Buddy presence for voice, vision, local model, and device-facing workflows.

links.reason: Omni Buddy should use shared graph context instead of maintaining isolated memory.

name: Prismtek Apps
summary: User-facing Prismtek application layer for Buddy app experiences and companion workflows.

links.reason: Apps should surface compiled Buddy context, preferences, and graph-backed status.
The app can expose council roles and review states as user-facing Buddy features.

name: Council
summary: Specialized review and decision roles that help Buddy plan, build, critique, and verify work.

links.reason: Council members need the shared graph to review against durable context.
Buddy Brain is the current governance and council continuity layer.

name: Codex Tasks
summary: Task execution workflow for code changes, checks, logs, and implementation handoffs.

links.reason: Task execution needs graph-backed repo context, project state, and prior decisions.
Buddy Agent should execute coding tasks with shared graph context.

name: Agent Browser
summary: Browser/workspace capability for agent-assisted navigation, inspection, and task workflows.

links.reason: Browser tasks need durable project memory and graph-backed source context.
The app can expose browser-assisted workflows through Buddy UI.

name: Knowledge Graph
summary: Machine-readable shared brain layer that connects concepts, repos, systems, and future agent memory records.

links.reason: KnowledgeVault stores the graph as public-safe JSONL and generated indexes.
Council roles should inspect graph context before reviewing or deciding.
